explanations: The abstract says measurements of the dielectric function reveal systematic trends and that metavalent solids have large dielectric constants and high epsilon2 values. This is relevant because those optical indicators are used as bonding descriptors, but the chunks do not specify a single dedicated instrument model and the output is more indirect than Raman or atom probe tomography.
